title: delaunay3D
body:
## delaunay3D

Builds a 3-D Delaunay tetrahedralization of the input points (any point set) and outputs an unstructured grid of tetrahedra filling their convex hull. A positive alpha (Schemaxis default 0) produces an alpha shape: only tetrahedra whose circumsphere radius is at most alpha, plus qualifying triangles, are kept, which recovers concave shapes from point clouds. Use it to mesh scattered 3-D samples for interpolation or volume estimates; use delaunay2D for surface-like sets and pvDelaunay3D to choose which alpha cell types are output.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Output grows quickly and ParaView warns that Delaunay 3D can exhaust memory; thin large point sets first.
- Points on a regular lattice are degenerate: the result depends on point order, and nearly coplanar points produce sliver tetrahedra.

Native constructor: `Delaunay3D`. Identity: `curated binding`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input dataset to the Delaunay 3D filter. Accepted data: explicit-point datasets (polygonal, unstructured or structured grids) (vtkPointSet). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkPointSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `alpha` | This property specifies the alpha (or distance) value to control the output of this filter. For a non-zero alpha value, only edges, faces, or tetra contained within the circumsphere (of radius alpha) will be output. Otherwise, only tetrahedra will be output. | `{"type":"number","minimum":0}` | `0` | `0` |
| `tolerance` | This property specifies a tolerance to control discarding of closely spaced points. This tolerance is specified as a fraction of the diagonal length of the bounding box of the points. | `{"type":"number","minimum":0}` | `0.001` | `0.001` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "delaunay3D",
  "inputs": {
    "input": "UPSTREAM_input"
  }
}
```
